problem_summary: A bob moves in a horizontal circle. Keeping its mass and radius fixed, compare the string tension when the speed doubles.
worked_solution: At fixed mass and radius, T=mv^2/r. Replacing v with 2v gives T'=m(2v)^2/r=4T.

problem_summary: A particle has position x(t)=2t-1 in SI units. For a 5 N force along its motion, find the instantaneous power.
worked_solution: v=dx/dt=2 m/s. For a force along the motion, P=Fv=5 N x 2 m/s=10 W.

problem_summary: A symmetric biconvex lens has refractive index 1.5 and surface radii of magnitude 20 cm. Find its power in air.
A square loop of side 1 m is perpendicular to a uniform 0.5 T magnetic field. Find the magnetic flux through it.
worked_solution: The loop area is 1 m^2 and its area normal is parallel to the field, so Phi=BA cos(0)=0.5 x 1 x 1=0.5 Wb.
